# Soil

**Tags:** `material`

Loose earth under a biome's cover, down to its `topsoilDepth`. It is what mining a slice of natural topsoil yields, whatever cover (`surfaceMaterial`) it wears — Grass, Moss, Ash and Void ground alike — and what farmland is made of.

> **Goal:** Give digging the surface a yield that is not rock

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `density` | decimal | yes | g/cm³ |
| `hardness` | decimal | yes | Mohs equivalent 1–10 |
| `depthBand` | json | yes | Depth band [min, max) in world units below the natural surface where a vein may form; empty when max <= min. A topsoil layer, never a buried vein. |
| `leyGated` | boolean | yes | True when a vein of this material forms only near a ley line |
